Budget Plan for Rock Climbing Hobby

Initial Costs (One-time purchases):
- Climbing Shoes: $80 - $150
- Harness: $50 - $100
- Carabiners (set of 5-8): $60 - $120
- Belay Device: $20 - $40
- Helmet: $40 - $80
- Chalk Bag & Chalk: $15 - $25
- Total Initial Investment Estimate: $265 - $515

Ongoing Costs:
- Gym Membership (if climbing indoors): $50 - $100 per month
- Outdoor Climbing Permits/Fees: $10 - $30 per trip
- Gear Maintenance/Replacement (shoes wear out every 6-12 months): $80 - $150 every 6-12 months
- Total Monthly Estimate: $50 - $100 (plus periodic gear replacement)

Note: Ropes are typically not recommended for beginners to purchase initially due to high cost and safety requirements; many climbers rent or use gym ropes. If purchasing a dynamic rope, add $100 - $200.
